question: Table tennis made its Olympic debut in ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1988**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Table Tennis made its Olympic debut in the year 1988** during the Summer Olympics held in **Seoul, South Korea**.

• It was included as a competitive sport with events for both **singles** and **doubles** categories for men and women.

• The inclusion of table tennis in the Olympics was a result of the growing popularity of the sport worldwide, especially in countries like **China, Japan, South Korea, and European nations**.

• **China dominated the event** from the very beginning and has maintained its stronghold on the sport, winning numerous medals across different categories.

• The Olympic table tennis competition follows rules set by the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF)
